input.prompt: A colored-pencil drawing on cream paper comes to life, a hand-drawn pencil drawing in every frame: same pencil lines, paper texture and hatching as the first frame, never a photo or 3D. She sings the words of the reference audio, 'I just ask myself what it is that I need', lips exactly in time with the voice: mouth opening on 'I', a short rounded 'j' on 'just', open on 'ask', lips pressing together on the 'm' of 'myself'. She performs like a real singer in a music video: her chest and shoulders rise and fall with her breathing; her head moves with the phrasing, small nods on the beat, a tilt to one side on the long notes, the chin lifting on the high note; her shoulders roll and her upper body sways gently side to side to the rhythm; her eyebrows lift with feeling, her eyes glance away and come back, she blinks naturally; her expression follows the words. Continuous, relaxed, natural movement, never stiff, never exaggerated; she stays in place. She sings it softly and thoughtfully, a small honest shrug of her shoulders on 'I just ask myself', her eyes searching up and to the side as if reading a screen, then turning inward; a cool blue screen glow lights her face. The grid and wireframe cubes behind her stay still. Same person as in the first frame: large head, heart-shaped face, soft chin, tall forehead with the high centre-parted hairline, the two slightly different eyebrows, the same big dark-brown eyes; do not restyle her face. Her hair stays up in the bun with the two yellow pencils crossing through it in an X, both eraser caps pointing up (one blue, one pink); the pencils move only together with her head and never fall. Headphones stay round her neck; the white jacket keeps its orange bands, ONE small pale-blue chest dot exactly where it is in the first frame and ONE 1420 MHz sleeve patch. Static camera, same framing, no zoom. No captions, no text, no new objects.
